data.gender_notes: Balinsh is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Balinsh is a Sanskrit name, derived from the word 'bal' meaning power and 'ins' meaning lord or ruler. The name signifies a powerful and brave individual in Hindu mythology. The name Balinsh carries the meaning “Powerful, Brave” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sansk Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Balinsh usually hope their child will grow to embody powerful, brave and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Embrace your inner strength and courage.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Balinsh total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.
